主要内容: Schweitzer-Mauduit International, Inc. appointed R. Andrew Wamser, Jr. as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, effective February 5, 2018. Wamser and Allison Aden will serve as Co-Chief Financial Officers until March 2, 2018. Aden will remain sole Principal Financial Officer until that date. Wamser previously worked at AutoNation, Inc. (AN) and Barclays Capital. His compensation includes a base salary of $435,000, a sign-on bonus of $155,000, and restricted stock vesting on the four-year anniversary of his start date. His 2018 AIP payout opportunity is 60% of base salary, with a maximum of 120%, and his LTIP opportunity is 100% of base salary, with a maximum of 200%. In case of a qualifying termination following a change in control, he would receive three times his highest annual compensation in severance. Aden transitioned to Co-Chief Financial Officer with Wamser until the Transition Date, after which she would serve as an employee until the Separation Date.
